functions.name: creator_access
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION glam_private.creator_access(cid uuid, writing boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.creator_profiles p
 WHERE p.id=cid AND glam_private.active_profile_id() IS NOT NULL AND
 ((p.organization_id IS NULL AND p.profile_id=glam_private.active_profile_id()) OR
  (p.organization_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM public.organization_members m
   JOIN public.organizations o ON o.id=m.organization_id
   JOIN public.workspace_capability c ON c.organization_id=o.id
   WHERE o.id=p.organization_id AND m.user_id=glam_private.current_app_user_id()
   AND m.active AND NOT o.suspended AND c.workspace='creator' AND c.status='verified' AND c.expires_at>now()
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.account_eligibility e WHERE e.user_id=m.user_id AND e.age_band='eligible_adult' AND e.expires_at>now())
   AND (m.role='owner' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.workspace_role r WHERE r.organization_id=o.id AND r.user_id=m.user_id AND r.workspace='creator'
     AND (NOT writing OR r.role IN ('admin','creator'))))))))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_analysis_correction()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND OLD.redacted_at IS NULL AND NEW.corrections IS NULL
    AND NEW.redacted_at IS NOT NULL AND
    (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['corrections','redacted_at'])=
    (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['corrections','redacted_at']) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Correction revisions are immutable except for privacy redaction';
END $function$

functions.name: guard_analysis_passport_owner
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_analysis_passport_owner()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.style_passports p JOIN public.app_user u
    ON u.id=NEW.owner_id AND u.subject=p.profile_id::text
    AND u.issuer='https://bkkmsbxrxkqaveymcrgi.supabase.co/auth/v1'
    WHERE p.id=NEW.passport_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Canonical passport owner mismatch';
  END IF;
  IF NEW.correction_revision>0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.analysis_correction c
    WHERE c.job_id=NEW.job_id AND c.owner_id=NEW.owner_id
      AND c.revision=NEW.correction_revision AND c.redacted_at IS NULL) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Correction snapshot unavailable';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$
